_meta.source: ls.* fields: same as depleting.json — synthesised by scaling kerbalism-fixture-baseline-crp.json (food/water down to ~25%, drain faster, scrubber broken). greenhouse.* fields: Kerbalism source at the pinned kerbalism-src checkout — src/Kerbalism/Modules/Greenhouse.cs (`Greenhouse.Data` + `SimulateGreenhouse`'s lighting gate: `bool lighting = natural + artificial >= g.light_tolerance;`) and GameData/KerbalismConfig/Profiles/Default.cfg's `kerbalism-greenhouse` part config (same constants as greenhouse-growing.json). Issue text is the real localization string #KERBALISM_Greenhouse_issue1 = 'insufficient lighting' (GameData/Kerbalism/Localization/en-us.cfg) — the prior fixture used the near-miss string 'insufficient light', not the real one. CORRECTED: removed the fabricated 'growth'/'timeToHarvestSec' fields — see greenhouse-growing.json's _meta for the full explanation (no growth/harvest-countdown concept exists anywhere in Kerbalism; Food is a continuous ResourceRecipe output, gated on/off by natural+artificial < light_tolerance with no partial-credit accumulator). `greenhouse.lampEcDrawPerSec` here is the derived actual draw `ec_rate * (artificial / light_tolerance)` from SimulateGreenhouse's recipe construction (2.5 * (120/400) = 0.75), not the raw ec_rate config constant (see greenhouse.ecRateMaxPerSec, unchanged from config). No greenhouse capture path exists yet in mod/GonogoKerbalismUplink and no widget consumes this fixture as of this fix.
